patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with asymmetrical two-column layouts (image and text) and centered content blocks, creating a varied but structured page flow.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, providing clear hierarchy, complemented by legible body text and smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels.
A vibrant brand purple is consistently used for primary calls to action and key brand elements, contrasting against a clean palette of white and light grey backgrounds.
The primary navigation bar sticks to the top of the viewport without any visual transformation (e.g., shrinking or background change) as the user scrolls.
Each major content block is clearly delineated with generous vertical spacing and often features a large, engaging image paired with a concise heading and call to action.

technique_notes: Content sections are structured using a mix of full-bleed imagery and text blocks, often arranged in a two-column grid that alternates alignment (image left/text right, then text left/image right) to maintain visual interest.
The primary navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element that remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, without any visual transformation or shrinking.
Call to action buttons utilize a solid brand purple background with subtle rounded corners, ensuring high contrast and immediate recognition against neutral backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with clear hierarchy and smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall with generous vertical padding between sections, creating an airy feel in the hero and clear separation of content blocks.

standout: The site's design stands out through its confident and consistent use of a vibrant brand purple as a primary accent, which effectively guides the user's eye to calls to action and key information without overwhelming the clean, neutral layout. It feels trustworthy and approachable, balancing clear information hierarchy with engaging imagery, without relying on complex animations.
